title: Group Anagrams
description:
Group words that are anagrams of each other.

Input format
Line 1: n, the number of words.
Next n lines: one lowercase word per line.

Output format
One line per group. Inside a group, the words are sorted alphabetically (duplicates kept) and separated by single spaces. The groups themselves are ordered alphabetically by their first word.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 1000. Each word has 1 to 50 lowercase letters.
hints: What do all anagrams of one word have in common that you can compute for any word?
Sort the letters of each word to get a key; words with the same key belong together. A dictionary from key to list of words does the grouping.
Sort the words inside each group and then sort the groups by their first word, as the output format requires.

examples.input:
6
eat
tea
tan
ate
nat
bat
examples.output:
ate eat tea
bat
nat tan
examples.explanation: eat/tea/ate share the letters a, e, t; tan/nat share a, n, t; bat is alone.
